sides.claim: Microsoft is viewed as a great business with strong cash flows, intelligent capital allocation, and massive intellectual property that existed before the AI boom, and is believed to be reasonably priced with the financial strength to withstand…

Risks to Microsoft include premature capital spending on AI, delays in deploying data centers postponing profits, and the possibility that early enthusiasm for AI is not shared by the broader population.
